title: Supervised, Unsupervised and Reinforcement Learning
description: Taxonomy of ML paradigms, labeled vs unlabeled data, reward signals, and application domains.

title: Handling Missing Data, Imputation and Scaling
description: Cleaning data pipelines: mean/median imputation, handling outliers, standardization, and min-max normalization.
subtopics: Outlier detection using IQR and Z-scores

title: Feature Encoding, Selection and Extraction
description: One-hot encoding, label encoding, filter/wrapper selection methods, and polynomial features.

title: Training, Validation and Test Splits, Cross-Validation
description: Splitting datasets, data leakage prevention, k-fold cross-validation, and stratified sampling.

title: Simple and Multiple Linear Regression, Cost Functions
description: Ordinary Least Squares, hypothesis function, Mean Squared Error (MSE), and gradient descent updates.

title: Binary Classification and Sigmoid Function
description: Logistic function, log-odds, binary cross-entropy loss, and decision boundary thresholding.

title: K-Nearest Neighbors Algorithm and Distance Metrics
description: Lazy learning, non-parametric classification/regression, Euclidean, Manhattan, and Minkowski distance.

title: Decision Trees, Entropy and Information Gain
description: Recursive binary splitting, CART, ID3, Shannon Entropy, Gini Impurity, and tree pruning.
subtopics: Max depth and min samples split

title: Precision, Recall, F1-Score and ROC-AUC
description: Confusion matrix, Accuracy paradox, Precision-Recall tradeoff, ROC curves, and AUC score.

title: Overfitting, Underfitting and Regularization
description: Model generalization, high bias vs high variance, L1 Lasso, and L2 Ridge regularization.

title: SVM, Hyperplanes and Kernel Trick
description: Maximum margin classifiers, support vectors, slack variables, and RBF/polynomial kernel functions.
subtopics: Kernel trick mapping to higher dimensions

title: Bayes Theorem and Naive Bayes Classifiers
description: Conditional probability, Bayes rule, conditional independence assumption, Gaussian, and Multinomial NB.

title: Bagging, Bootstrap Aggregating and Random Forests
description: Ensemble learning, bootstrap sampling, variance reduction, random feature subspace, and OOB error.

title: AdaBoost, Gradient Boosting and XGBoost
description: Sequential ensemble learning, sample reweighting (AdaBoost), residual fitting, and gradient boosted trees.

title: K-Means Clustering and Elbow Method
description: Unsupervised partitioning, centroid initialization (K-Means++), WCSS inertia, and silhouette analysis.

title: Principal Component Analysis and Dimensionality Reduction
description: Unsupervised feature extraction, covariance matrix decomposition, eigenvectors, eigenvalues, and explained variance.
